selection.rule: All price-audit cuts meeting the original 70% reconstructed-history coverage threshold; no outcome-availability or performance filter

reconstruction_clock_semantics: Recorded start of this retrospective input review; fixed for reproducible snapshot compilation, not historical retrieval or a rerun completion timestamp
sample_role: Previously inspected retrospective development data; six additional origins do not constitute an independent holdout
input_policy: Reuse the original compiler and its prior-day EPS, macro, holdings clocks, price reconstruction, dividend units and absent-quality penalties. Do not import current quality, analyst estimates, bond profiles or GJR fits. Record all 48 scheduled cuts and all exclusions.
forecast_policy: referenceRequest -> prepareComposition -> production generatePaths, with daily one-year paths and 21/63/252 prefixes. Keep the deployed preselection. No optimization, orders or continuous account. New per-origin archives; never replace the two-origin pilot or combine counts as independent experiments.
baseline: Same prepared EWMA covariance, zero arithmetic mean, flat Gaussian variance, no regime mixture or anchor uncertainty. Joint component comparison, not identification of incremental alpha.
target: Gross reinvested total-return proxy from exact adjusted endpoints, before cash-dividend accounting. Exclude later documented non-split adjustments through the frozen outcome market cut. No per-asset date shift or fallback for missing outcomes.
inference: Per-origin/horizon descriptions with every pending outcome retained. No pooled p-values or confidence intervals, no predictive calibration certification. Report overlap and immature origins explicitly.
freezing: Publish protocol and per-origin forecasts before scoring outcomes. Inputs and periods were previously studied; this is not prospective preregistration. Do not tune seeds, parameters, selection or risk limits after scoring.
